skill.name: shadcn-components
skill.description: Add or customize shadcn/ui components in the shared UI package. Use when adding new components from shadcn registry or updating existing component variants.

generated_query:
I need to add a dropdown select component (like a standard HTML select but with more styling and accessibility) to our shared UI package. Our project uses `packages/ui/` as the central component library. I want to use the shadcn select component because it supports keyboard navigation, form integration, and our existing components are built with shadcn. 

First, search for the correct component name in the shadcn registry (I think it's called "select" but want to confirm). Then get the exact CLI command to add it. After adding the component, I'll need to export it from the library's index file so other apps can import it. Finally, I'll create a simple country selector component in our web app using this new select, with a few options like "United States", "Canada", "Mexico". Can you help me with each step?
